title: Implement tenant-bound authoritative Persona training targets
summary_zh: training-authority-contract-audit.json 與 report.md 3.1 節指出：services/training-session/persona_target.py 的凍結 validator 要求 Persona owner 提供 tenant_id/generation/authority_status/controller_record_ref/recorded_at 的 precondition readback、接受 generation/precondition-digest/approved-teaching-proof 綁定的 target writer，以及該 generation 的 terminal target readback，但既有 services/persona/write_owner.py 只有一般 create/patch/lifecycle/capability-snapshot 端點，完全沒有這三個介面。此任務只在 services/persona/write_owner.py 新增一個獨立、持久化、tenant 綁定的 training-target 資源（GET+POST /api/personas/{persona_id}/training-target），滿足凍結 validator 的每一個必填欄位與 CAS/idempotency 語意，不修改 persona_target.py 本身、不碰 Governance owner（DOMAIN-WRITERS-001 範圍），也不改動既有 PersonaBody 的一般欄位語意。

owned: New PersistentPersonaTrainingTargetOwner: a durable, tenant-bound, generation-versioned record per persona_id, backed by the same AtomicJsonRecordStore/PostgresJsonOwnerStore pattern already used by PersistentPersonaOwner and PersistentCapabilitySnapshotOwner

GET /api/personas/{persona_id}/training-target (X-Tenant-Id header): serves as the frozen contract's persona precondition readback both for a standalone pre-evaluation read and for commit_persona_target's internal pre-readback, and as the terminal readback after a commit -- one durable resource read at every stage, no in-process cache or fixture fallback

POST /api/personas/{persona_id}/training-target (X-Tenant-Id, Idempotency-Key headers): commits one approved teaching target via compare-and-set on generation; enforces tenant isolation (403 TRAINING_TARGET_TENANT_MISMATCH via first-writer-wins tenant binding), stale-generation rejection (409), and idempotent-replay-vs-conflict semantics at the already-committed generation (identical binding replays 200 with replayed=true, differing binding is a 409 semantic idempotency conflict)

Reuses the existing service-token / JWT persona.admin authentication path (_authenticate_persona_mutation, _require_persona_plane_owner) for both new endpoints; requires the persona_id to already exist in the real PersistentPersonaOwner store before any training-target read or write is served

Root GPT-6 Astra integration review (PR5603, /tmp/dev-persona-authority-root-review-20260905.md) reproduced four exact defects against head 2adefe969cc5c0ef77f5052a27f362ba12ef7424 with the real owner classes directly (bypassing the training-session client validator); this revision fixes all four at the owner boundary itself: (1) a hostile first GET could durably bind an arbitrary tenant to a persona's training-target authority -- read() now returns a deterministic, unpersisted generation-0 view for any caller and only a fully verified commit may durably create the record and bind tenant_id; (2) commit() previously stored approval_decision_id/precondition/candidate/control/proof digests without verifying them -- it now independently re-derives candidate_digest/control_digest from the actual submitted content via a self-contained _canonical_digest (mirroring, not importing, persona_target.py's canonical_digest), checks the evaluation_proof is internally self-consistent and status=='passed', checks its target_precondition matches this exact persona/tenant/generation/precondition binding, and calls a new injectable TrainingTargetApprovalVerifier (default HttpGovernanceApprovalVerifier hitting Governance's own /api/governance/approvals/{decision_id}) to independently prove the claimed approval is real, approved, unexpired, and bound to this exact identity -- an unconfigured verifier fails closed with TRAINING_TARGET_APPROVAL_VERIFIER_UNAVAILABLE (503) rather than minting authority; (3) a replay at an already-committed generation now re-runs the same digest/proof verification and additionally requires the resubmitted Idempotency-Key to match the one stored at commit time, so a caller cannot swap real candidate/proof content while keeping stale claimed digests and a different key and have it accepted as an idempotent replay; (4) a successful commit now calls the real PersistentPersonaOwner.patch(...) to record the applied training-target generation/controller_record_ref/control_digest/candidate_digest/approval_decision_id into the actual Persona record's metadata, so GET /api/personas/{persona_id} observably changes and reads back changed after a restart, instead of only a second receipt-only store
not_changing: services/training-session/persona_target.py -- the frozen client validator (PR #5593 head 48e32ff7427294be633b05bff66a110f91592c96) is exercised as-is via its public read_persona_target_precondition/commit_persona_target functions, loaded standalone exactly as its own test suite does; not one line of it is edited

The Governance owner service and its approval-decision contract (DOMAIN-WRITERS-001 scope) -- the approval readback the frozen validator performs is out of this task and is served from a fixed in-memory fake in the new focused tests

The existing generic Persona lifecycle/CRUD fields (PersonaBody.status/lifecycle_state and friends) -- the new training-target authority projection is a separate resource so the admin status vocabulary ({active, suspended, archived}) is never overloaded with the validator's distinct {active, committed} vocabulary
execute-plans FE PR #738 (head dbdb2f4ac621075e47f67f9b567b94f0cb06e6e2) -- untouched, no frontend files in this diff
No live credentials, no dev/prod deployment or mutation -- everything below runs against a temporary AtomicJsonRecordStore under pytest's tmp_path
known_gap: Deployment wiring (TRAINING_SESSION_PERSONA_READBACK_URL_TEMPLATE / _TARGET_WRITE_URL_TEMPLATE / _TARGET_READBACK_URL_TEMPLATE all pointing at this new resource path on the live persona-svc host) and hosted/dev acceptance are explicitly out of scope per the task brief -- root GPT-6 Astra owns integration validation and dev deployment. This delivery only proves the Persona-owner contract itself, end to end, against the exact frozen validator.

The real Governance approval verifier is a genuine, typed, fail-closed contract dependency, not fabricated authority: build_training_target_approval_verifier() returns HttpGovernanceApprovalVerifier only when PERSONA_TRAINING_TARGET_GOVERNANCE_BASE_URL and a service token (PANTHEON_GOVERNANCE_SERVICE_TOKEN or PANTHEON_PERSONA_SERVICE_TOKEN) are configured; until that dev/prod wiring exists, every commit fails closed with 503 TRAINING_TARGET_APPROVAL_VERIFIER_UNAVAILABLE. Tests exercise the same verification logic against an in-memory _FakeGovernanceApprovalVerifier double (registers only approvals a test has proven were really issued) rather than a live Governance host, per this task's no-live-credentials constraint.

acceptance_mapping.training_authority_readback_write_readba: test_precondition_read_commit_and_restart_readback exercises the real frozen persona_target.read_persona_target_precondition and commit_persona_target functions (unmodified) against the new owner endpoints end to end, including the terminal-readback digest/generation/controller_record_ref checks the validator itself enforces
acceptance_mapping.tenant_isolation_generation_cas_idempote: PersistentPersonaTrainingTargetOwner.commit(): first-writer-wins tenant binding + compare_and_set on generation + binding-equality check at the already-committed generation
acceptance_mapping.cross_tenant_denial: test_cross_tenant_read_and_write_are_denied (GET and POST both return 403 for a second tenant against an already-tenant-bound persona)
acceptance_mapping.first_reader_tenant_hijack_denial: test_first_reader_cannot_hijack_tenant_via_read -- root review finding #1: two different unrelated tenants each GET a never-committed persona and both see the same unpersisted generation-0 view (no lock-in); the legitimate tenant's real first commit still succeeds afterward, and the hostile tenant is then durably denied (403)
acceptance_mapping.unissued_approval_denial: test_commit_rejects_unissued_approval -- root review finding #2 (approval_decision_id=never-issued-approval): posts the owner endpoint directly with a syntactically valid but never-registered approval_decision_id; the owner's TrainingTargetApprovalVerifier call returns false and the commit is rejected without ever being applied
acceptance_mapping.wrong_precondition_denial: test_commit_rejects_wrong_precondition_digest -- root review finding #2 (wrong precondition digest): the owner independently recomputes/compares the proof's target_precondition.precondition_digest against expected_precondition_digest and rejects the mismatch (422) instead of trusting the caller's claim
acceptance_mapping.failed_proof_denial: test_commit_rejects_failed_evaluation_proof -- root review finding #2 (evaluation proof with status=failed): the owner checks evaluation_proof.status == 'passed' itself and rejects a self-consistent but failed proof (422)
acceptance_mapping.stale_generation: test_stale_generation_commit_is_rejected (a commit attempt whose expected_previous_generation no longer matches the current stored generation after two real commits returns 409)
acceptance_mapping.mismatched_or_expired_approval: already covered by the untouched frozen suite services/training-session/tests/test_persona_target.py (test_future_or_expired_approval_fails_closed, test_approval_identity_must_match_expected_proof_policy_authority) for the client boundary; the owner boundary's own independent approval verification is additionally covered by test_commit_rejects_unissued_approval and HttpGovernanceApprovalVerifier's expiry check
acceptance_mapping.semantic_idempotency_conflict: test_semantic_idempotency_conflict_rejects_reused_generation_new_payload (same generation, different session/binding, rejected) and test_replay_with_swapped_content_same_claimed_digests_is_rejected -- root review finding #3: a second request with genuinely different candidate content but stale claimed digests and a different Idempotency-Key is rejected (not replayed=true) because the owner recomputes digests from the real submitted content and checks the stored idempotency_key, rather than trusting caller-supplied digest fields
acceptance_mapping.actual_policy_control_change_and_restart: test_precondition_read_commit_and_restart_readback re-instantiates PersistentPersonaOwner/PersistentPersonaTrainingTargetOwner from the same on-disk JSON path in a fresh FastAPI app + TestClient, confirms the exact committed generation/digests/controller_record_ref read back identically, and additionally asserts (root review finding #4) that GET /api/personas/{persona_id} itself now carries the applied training_target_generation/controller_record_ref/control_digest in its metadata -- a real owner mutation, not a second receipt-only store
acceptance_mapping.no_fabricated_controller_receipts_or_saf: controller_record_ref values for a committed generation are generated server-side per commit (uuid4-based, generation-scoped) only inside the real compare-and-set write path; the generation-0 view is deterministic and never persisted; no test or implementation code short-circuits the validator's authority_status/controller_record_ref/recorded_at/digest checks, and the new approval verifier fails closed rather than fabricating a receipt when unconfigured
